records.title: Sciences Po Europe scholarship
records.summary: Any students whose circumstances meet the social criteria defined by France's student finance administrator, the Crous, and have successfully completed their administrative and course registration at Sciences Po, are eligible to receive the Sciences Po Europe Bursary during their first year of study.
records.amount: A complete tuition fee exemption A living costs grant equivalent to 175% of the sum defined by the Crous. That means a grant ranging between €1,824 and €10,038 in 2021/2022, depending on where you fall on the Crous' eligibility scale. The sum is paid in 10 monthly instalments between September and June. Priority consideration for accommodation in student residences or with Sciences Po's other housing partners. We take into account three factors when determining whether students are eligible for the bursary and how much they are eligible for: Household income Number of children financially dependent on the household Distance of student's residence from their place of study

Celles-ci comprennent les avantages suivants pour tous les candidats sélectionnés : - Versement d'une allocation de 925€ pour un séjour de deux semaines et de 1850€ pour un séjour d'un mois. - Affiliation à un régime d'assurance maladie comprenant la responsabilité civile pendant toute la durée du séjour. - Possibilité d'hébergement à tarif préférentiel (dont le loyer ne dépassera pas le tiers du montant de l'allocation). - Acheminement vers le lieu d'accueil en train (2nde classe) depuis un aéroport international dans le cas où la ville d'études ne bénéficierait pas d'une liaison directe avec la ville d'origine du bénéficiaire. Les frais annexes de taxi, navette, bus, métro ne sont pas pris en charge. - Activités culturelles à tarifs préférentiels proposées par Campus France.

records.title: France Excellence Scholarships - Theology and Religions
records.summary: The French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs is funding scholarships in theology and religions (at Master's and doctoral levels) as well as high-level scientific stays in the aforementioned fields for 2026. In this regard, the IFA is launching a call for applications from March 17 to April 14, 2026.
records.amount: Terms and Conditions: - The stipend for a Master's level scholarship is €900 per month; The stipend for a Doctoral level scholarship is €1,850 per month; - The stipend for a High-Level Scientific Stay Grant (SSHN) at the "young researcher" rate is €1,850 per month; - The stipend for a High-Level Scientific Stay Grant (SSHN) at the "established researcher" rate is €2,055 per month; - In accordance with the scholarship regulations applicable as of January 1, 2023, tuition fees are not covered. - Round-trip travel and any prior language training are not covered. - If the student's accommodation is provided by a religious institution or association, the application must be indicated.

records.amount: En plus de ce soutien pédagogique, l'OFAJ t'attribue une bourse de 1 300 € par mois pendant ton séjour en France et il subvient à tes frais de déplacement et tes frais pédagogiques. records.title: Rohan grant
records.summary: The Institut français d'Autriche and the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs are offering an artist residency grant: the Rohan grant.
records.amount: The grant is worth €1,850 per month and is awarded to a writer or translator with a one-month research and/or creative residency project (grant calculated on a pro-rata basis) in France in 2026 in the literary fields.

records.title: Le Detroit Scholarship
records.summary: The Le Détroit Scholarship supports Michigan college and university students who are pursuing studies in business or other professional fields (for example, finance, engineering, and international relations) alongside French language courses.
